title: Hoshino Ichika — Let Me Hear That Song〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I know you just got here, but I came up with some lyrics for that song you wrote. Mind taking a look at them for me?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, it fits perfectly with that song!
Nice work, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks...
But I have a feeling that it's still missing some pieces.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right... It's hard for me to describe... I can't quite put my finger on it...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (This song is all about what Saki experienced personally.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But I'm only aware of a small portion of that. Which is why my lyrics aren't really reaching Saki's heart...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um, Saki? Did you write any notes when you were writing that song? I'd like to use them as reference if you did...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I did! Just gimme a sec...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Here it is!
This is the notebook I use when writing songs!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Mind if I look at it now...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, hang on... Reading it may not be very fun... It's a place where I literally write down whatever comes to mind.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(“Why me?”
“I don't wanna do more tests...”)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Being stuck in the hospital must've been worse than I realized... And yet, she always tried to smile to make sure none of us became worried...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You don't have to keep going if you don't want to. I know it's not exactly what you call a pleasant read...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Saki...
There's one more thing I'd like to ask of you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If it's okay with you, would you mind telling me what you thought about as you wrote this song?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: About the pain you felt, all those awful tests, how it felt being stuck in that hospital room... Everything.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: B-But hearing it's probably not gonna do you any favors. I mean, it'll feel like you're sinking into a really dark place...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I'm fine with that.
If anything, I'm prepared to feel what you did.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I want a better understanding of that loneliness you felt, Saki...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I want to feel the pain you expressed in that song... I want to know what it's really about...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's why I want you to tell me about everything you felt.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'll tell you everything about what I felt while writing this song.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, I should be the one thanking you...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
So, Ichi, thanks.
I really appreciate how you're trying to get a better understanding of me.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I promise to write lyrics that do this song justice and really hit home with you.
